text_block_list.text:
After our outing, on the road back
to the academy with Rice Shower—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah—
Look, dear brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah—
Look, Onee-sama!
Perched on Rice Shower's outstretched finger was a tiny little ladybug.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Did you know?
Ladybugs are symbols of good luck.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"It's my first time having one land on me like this...
I wonder if... something good will happen...?"

Afterward, a thirsty Rice Shower
bought a juice from a vending machine, and—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wait, no way! It's a winner...!
Rice Shower blinks in surprise at the vending machine flashing brightly to signal a "Winner."
choice_data_list: We're in luck right off the bat!
We're in luck right off the bat, huh!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah!
Winning a prize from a vending machine, it's the first time in my life—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But...

Rice Shower suddenly cast her eyes downward.
...She seemed somewhat uneasy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I just got... a little scared.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"When I get lucky... like this...
I can't help but worry I'll bring misfortune to everyone next."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "Because... that's how Rice's whole life has been... up until now..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But you know.
What I hate most right now is—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice herself, thinking like this.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even though something nice happened...
Even though Rice is with you, Big Brother... I...
choice_data_list: I'll just have to bring even more happiness than the unhappiness I caused — that's what Rice will do.
Let's make that a memory too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even though something nice happened...
Even though Rice is with you, Big Sister... I...
choice_data_list: I'll just have to bring even more happiness than the unhappiness I caused — that's what Rice will do.
Let's make that a memory too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Right, you're right. That's what Rice wants to do,
and that's why Rice is here, but..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I can't help wondering if I can do it... or if it's just impossible...
I keep dwelling on it—
choice_data_list: Let me help you with that.
Let me help you with that.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I might not be able to do it alone, but...
if it's with you, Big Brother... maybe I can...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I might not be able to do it alone, but...
if it's with you, Big Sister... maybe I can...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No.
I want to be able to do it...!

It seems Rice Shower's outlook
has brightened just a little.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Turn misfortune... into memories...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I've never even thought about that.
Do you really think I can...?
choice_data_list: I'll treasure that as a memory with Rice Shower.
I'll cherish that as a precious memory with you, Rice.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I feel like... with you, Dear Brother, maybe I can do it...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I feel like... with you, Dear Sister, maybe I can do it...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No.
I wish I could do it...

A little bit of sorrow
vanished from Rice Shower's expression.
